result.instructions: Tools for Formitize, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which jobs are still open for this week, and who is assigned to each?"; "Show me the latest submitted inspection forms for job 245."; "List the CRM tasks assigned to user 45 that are due this month.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Formitize data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run formitize_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run formitize_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run formitize_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. formitize_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: formitize_list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs
tools.description: List jobs (work orders). Returns unfinished jobs by default; set finished to true for finished jobs. Up to 500 per call. Formitize API: GET /job/.

finished.description: true = finished jobs; default = unfinished jobs.

from.description: Earliest date to list (YYYY-MM-DD or Unix timestamp).

to.description: Latest date to list (YYYY-MM-DD or Unix timestamp).

agentName.description: Filter by the assigned agent (user) name.

tools.name: formitize_get_job
tools.title: Get a job
tools.description: Get one job by id: client, contact, title, job and order numbers, status, forms attached to the job and invoice id. Formitize API: GET /job/{id}.

tools.name: formitize_get_job_history
tools.title: Get job history
tools.description: Get the change history of one job: edits, status changes and their times. Formitize API: GET /job/{id}/history.

tools.name: formitize_list_form_templates
tools.title: List form templates
tools.description: List the form templates in the account (id, title, dates). Use the id with formitize_get_form_template. Formitize API: GET /form/list.

simple.description: true = return the simplified form without the schema data.

tools.name: formitize_get_form_template
tools.title: Get a form template
tools.description: Get one form template with its field layout (elements and their types). Formitize API: GET /form/{id}.

simple.description: true = return the simplified form without the schema data.

tools.name: formitize_list_submitted_forms
tools.title: List submitted forms
tools.description: List submitted forms (form entries), newest first, 200 per page. Filter by title, job, template or modified date. Formitize API: GET /form/submit/list.

job_id.description: Only forms attached to this job id.

form_id.description: Only forms from this template id.

modified_after_date.description: Only forms modified after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: formitize_get_submitted_form
tools.title: Get a submitted form
tools.description: Get one submitted form with its answers, the submitting user, the job and the GPS position. Formitize API: GET /form/submit/{id}.

simple.description: true = return the simplified form without the schema data.

tools.name: formitize_list_asset_types
tools.title: List asset types
tools.description: List the asset types (schemas) with their column names. Use the id with formitize_list_assets. Formitize API: GET /asset/schema/list.

tools.name: formitize_list_assets
tools.title: List assets
tools.description: List the assets of one asset type, with their schema columns. Formitize API: GET /asset/list/{schemaID}/.

tools.name: formitize_get_asset
tools.title: Get an asset
tools.description: Get one asset by id, with its asset type schema, client, location and field values. Formitize API: GET /asset/{schemaID}/{assetID}.

tools.name: formitize_list_lookup_databases
tools.title: List lookup databases
tools.description: List the lookup database tables with their column names. Formitize API: GET /database/list.

tools.name: formitize_list_tasks
tools.title: List CRM tasks
tools.description: List CRM tasks with optional filters. Paginated. Formitize API: GET /crm/task/.

assigned_to.description: Only tasks assigned to this user id.

client_id.description: Only tasks for this client id.

task_type.description: Filter by task type (for example Call).

from.description: Earliest due date (YYYY-MM-DD or Unix timestamp).

to.description: Latest due date (YYYY-MM-DD or Unix timestamp).

order.description: Sort order, as the Formitize API accepts it.

tools.name: formitize_get_task
tools.title: Get a CRM task
tools.description: Get one CRM task with its related client or job and attachments. Formitize API: GET /crm/task/{id}.

tools.name: formitize_create_task
tools.title: Create a CRM task
tools.description: WRITE: create a new CRM task. Each call makes a new task, so do not repeat it. Formitize API: POST /crm/task/.

due_date.description: Due date as a Unix timestamp (seconds).

assigned_to.description: The user id the task is assigned to.

status.description: The status number, as formitize_get_task returns it.

tools.name: formitize_update_task
tools.title: Update a CRM task
tools.description: WRITE: update a CRM task. Only the fields you pass change. Repeating the same call gives the same result. Formitize API: POST /crm/task/{id}.

due_date.description: New due date as a Unix timestamp (seconds).
